title: Why Earning $300M Wasn't Enough to Save Him
description:
Mike Tyson's 2003 bankruptcy filing is a classic case study of how a massive income cannot survive without a financial defense system. Wealth isn't what you earn—it is what you keep.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
